name: Shinonome Suzu
source:
[b]A Surprisingly Domestic Childhood Friend-Type Gyaru[/b]

A girl who’s both Hatsune’s childhood friend and current classmate.
She’s had feelings for Hatsune since they were kids, but those feelings only grew stronger after she moved away.

She’s good at cooking and genuinely enjoys it—her dream is to one day open her own restaurant. To work toward that goal, she’s currently studying while working part-time at a café. Back when they were kids, most people laughed at her dream, but Hatsune was the only one who didn’t mock her—he took her seriously and supported her. Because of that, even though she’s surprised to see Hatsune now crossdressing as a gyaru, she doesn’t reject it. Instead, she wants to support him.

More than anything, she’s determined to cheer Hatsune on. No matter who he ends up dating, she’s committed to putting Hatsune’s happiness first.


•Her birthday it's the same day as the "Coffee shop Day"
•She is good at: Cooking, Housework.
•She is bad at: Waking up early.

[i]"Well, no matter who it is, I'll cheer them on! ♪"[/i]
